headline: Net income grows but EPS slips on a larger share count
summary_short: Diluted EPS was $1.03, down 1.9% y/y (+24.1% q/q), as net income rose 3.2% y/y to $483M but per-share results were diluted by a larger share count following Entergy's $2.175B forward common-stock offering.
summary_long: Q2 2026 net income of $483M (+3.2% y/y) reflected the net effect of regulatory rate actions, return on construction work in progress, higher retail sales volume, and higher other income, partially offset by higher interest expense, O&M, and depreciation. Diluted EPS fell 1.9% y/y to $1.03 despite the net income gain, consistent with a higher share count after Entergy's $2.175B forward common-stock offering. Utility segment earnings rose 4.5% to $626M with EPS flat at $1.34; Parent & Other's loss widened to $143M on higher interest expense. Weather was a $3M favorable tailwind in Q2 2026 versus $38M in Q2 2025, a $35M unfavorable swing. Entergy affirmed FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $4.25-$4.45.
